submitted.rationale: Across the five measured points, EQE was highest at index 0 (Sb=0.085, 0.00293%). Next came index 4 (0.00167%), then the MgSb2O6-bearing Sb-rich end at index 29 (0.00096%). Mid-line points 14 and 24 were about zero. The trend increases toward the Mg-rich end, so the lowest-Sb composition was the best measured. All values are very small because the 2.4 eV light is well below the band gap of Mg-Sb oxides.

rejected.reason: EQE 0.00011%. XRD shows mostly Pt substrate with a weak trirutile peak.
Crystalline MgSb2O6 trirutile plus excess Sb. EQE 0.00096% is below the Mg-rich end.
EQE 0.00167%, lower than index 0. XRD shows only Pt, so the film is amorphous or poorly crystallized.
